newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.AFRICA NETS SMUGGLED GOODS WORTH 5.56 MLN RAND.
newsitem.headline: S.AFRICA NETS SMUGGLED GOODS WORTH 5.56 MLN RAND.

text.p: Finance Minister Trevor Manuel said on Wednesday that South Africa had this year confiscated smuggled goods worth 5.56 million rand, ranging from clothing to frozen chickens.

Clothing valued at 1.2 million rand was seized and would be given to welfare organisations across Africa, he said in reply to a question in parliament. He did not give exact dates, saying only the hauls were recent.
A total of 1.17 billion cigarettes, worth 280,000 rand, were confiscated and would be handed out in South African prisons, he added.

Illegal textile imports valued at 1.28 million rand would be sold for export only, while 23,500 kg of frozen chicken portions seized at ports would be sold by tender if fit for human consumption. Other goods would be sold on state warehouse sales, Manuel said.
